usage.summary: GoodUI Typography supplies content structure and spacing without page-specific margin rules. The Penpot source is `12 Typography`; [typography-components.json](../../design/typography-components.json) maps every published component and variant to its Angular selector. The [homepage example](../../homepage/src/app/getting-started/typography.html) shows the system in use.
